text_block_list.text:
Today's autumn Tenno Sho will go down
in
history.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And there's the hot pick, Сайленс Судзука!
She's
done brilliantly in the graded races
up to this
point, but will she manage to
hold out to the
end? Let the autumn
Tenno Sho begin!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Just as we all expected, Сайленс Судзука
simply
refuses to give up the lead! She
takes first place
once again!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Otherworldly Front-Runner, who
leaves all
her opponents in the dust like
a flash of lightning,
looks rather
subdued as she approaches me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm really sorry for how
unreasonable I
was about the race.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to, but I essentially forced
you and
Spe into letting me
participate...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But still—I'm so glad I was able to run in
the end!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The scenery was so, so beautiful. My
heart is still
pounding just thinking
about it.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
She is unusually talkative, and almost
breathless
with excitement. Though I
can't help but smile at
her, I am still
concerned about her leg.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's all right, don't worry. I can still do
some light
running on it.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But I think I should focus on recovering
for a
while...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Why are you so surprised?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: I never thought I'd hear you prioritize rest.

text_block_list.text:
Oh. I guess it is a bit out of character for
me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: It's kind of a long story, but...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
When I was turning the third corner
during the
race, there was a split second
where I couldn't
move my leg.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it was because it was already
weakened...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: But I was so afraid, I nearly lost all heart.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I was so close to the scenery I wanted to
see so
badly. All I needed to do was
push myself a bit
longer...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But I was scared. I thought about how
the next
step I took might be my last.
How I might never
be able to run again.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But then, I heard a voice call out my
name—your
voice.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Oh yeah, I think I was cheering for you...

text_block_list.text:
Your voice made me remember the
promise we
made.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, I'll come back
to you. I
promise.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list:
I know you will. I'll be waiting for you at the
finish line.

text_block_list.text:
And, without thinking, I had taken that
next stЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Once I had, I found my stride again, and
I was
sprinting past the finish line before
I realized it.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The scenery beyond the finish line was

unbelievably beautiful...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It was then that the thought crossed my

mind—that, together, we can overcome
anything
that stands in our way.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I thought the Tenno Sho would mark the
end of
my athletic peak, but I realized
it's far too early
to decide something
like that!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The glow of the setting sun makes her
fervent
expression sparkle brilliantly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Deep in my heart, I still want to see
more and
more beautiful scenery, and to
push my limits
even further.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I know I can manage it, so long as I'm
with you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list:
Is that why you want to take time off to
recover?

text_block_list.text: That's right.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Her soft smile betrays a rare sense of

embarrassment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Once my leg is healed, let's go out in
search of
more beautiful scenery.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And so, the Tenno Sho becomes a
critical turning
point in our journey
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After focusing on her recovery, Silence
Suzuka is
back to full health, and we're
ready to challenge
her limits again!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
